labeller_note: Read batch-h1.json, vocabulary.md, the 13 workflow YAMLs and parts of workflow_registry.py (claim tables). Results are recorded only where words name a wanted result; open-ended or method-choice requests and bare 'run X on files' requests without result words get no result (noted). Produces lists every id whose entry gives the result as asked: an aggregate TF-to-gene network is matched by PANDA, OTTER, GIRAFFE's signed matrix and LIONESS-PANDA (which also writes the aggregate); likewise LIONESS-PUMA/LIONESS-DRAGON for aggregate TF+miRNA and two-layer networks; TF-only wording excludes PUMA. Alternative readings the user cannot choose between are recorded as separate results with a note. Settings include data declarations that BONOBO takes as settings (log_transformed, centered, genes_axis) and SAMBAR.cluster when clustering is stated; output paths and GMT filename formats are not labelled. Omics layers are assigned to omics_layer_1/2 in mention order unless a lambda assignment fixes them; RNA data paired with another layer goes to an omics-layer slot, otherwise expression_file. A miRNA-target prior fills motif_file (PUMA's combined regulator prior); miRNA expression has no slot. Source is recorded where the request says a result is computed from/on/using specific data.
